Review: Definitely wanted to like this place, and I’ll give it to them that it’s a nice space. However, we waited over an hour for an appetizer platter that was pretty underwhelming (a few cold nacho chips, cold shrimp, average salsas, and tostadas …MoreDefinitely wanted to like this place, and I’ll give it to them that it’s a nice space. However, we waited over an hour for an appetizer platter that was pretty underwhelming (a few cold nacho chips, cold shrimp, average salsas, and tostadas that were basically a corn chip with a few toppings). We’d ordered that while we were deciding on our mains, but it took so long that we just passed and went somewhere else. To note, there were barely any people in the restaurant and about 5 service staff, no clue how it could take that amount of time and no one really seemed to care. Overall I’d give the food a two star, but the lack of decent service gives it a one. To kick it off, I’d asked for half the bill on my credit card at the end and confirmed with the server that she’d charge half. When it came back she’d just charged the whole amount. It might be worth checking this place out for taco Tuesday or happy hour purely for the view, but there are definitely better options for a regular night. Overall bill for the chips and two drinks was about 30 dollars.

Review: I first became aware of the Haroo chain when looking for a restaraunt to eat in with my wife at the Kuah night market. …MoreI first became aware of the Haroo chain when looking for a restaraunt to eat in with my wife at the Kuah night market.Unfortunately, that particular branch was not halal, as most would expect from Korean restaraunt as they love their pork. Here we are, at the Haroo restaraunt just off Cenang beach. This particular branch is Halal and there is NO pork on offering (thank you!). My god...was it bloody worth it!For starters, I ordered "gun mandu" which are chicken dumplings. These were light on the stomach, although fried, they weren't overly greasy and you could taste the flavour, especially when dipped in the complimentary soy/chilli sauce. Lovely start.Now we get to the mains, I ordered the beef "bokeum" and my wife ordered the chicken "tukbaegi". As most food lovers know, you first eat with your eyes and this was the case. As soon as the dishes hit the table I instantly knew that I would want second and thirds. As soon as I put the first spoon of rice and beef bokeum in my mouth... I had the second spoon lined up and so forth. It was that good! Spoon after spoon until a short while later I was disappointed that I had finished!Man... The beef was so tender, the sauce was juicy and had that nice bbq kick and with the rice it added that texture that bound it altogether.I cannot speak on behalf of my wife's Chicken Tukbaegi, but she said it was the best dish she had in Langkawi and we were there for 4 days.Coming to a close with our bellies full, the hospitality was superb. The owners offered a generous grapefruit tasting mocktail and some form of vanilla ice cream complimentary.I've never felt so full and satisfied whilst I was in Langkawi. Easily the first place I'd recommend anyone to eat at!Just an FYI, as with most restaraunt in and around Cenang, make sure to bring cash. It isn't really a problem or detracts from the food itself. Just a general tip.(I only have a video of the food unfortunately... Wish Google would let me upload it).

Author: Afiq Ahmad Feisal
Review: This little hidden gem was one of the highlights of our trip! The entrance is located next to a white house, tucked away under some lush greenery, where a little walkway takes you to the bar and restaurant behind the house. Currently (26 …MoreThis little hidden gem was one of the highlights of our trip! The entrance is located next to a white house, tucked away under some lush greenery, where a little walkway takes you to the bar and restaurant behind the house. Currently (26 Sep 2021) the place is still running on a limited menu as it has only just reopened following the pandemic. We ordered the Beef Goulash, Pork Cordon Bleu, Apple Strudel and two glasses of red wine, and everything was extremely delicious and warmed us up as we are during the evening rain. The ambience was cozy, and the chef, Adeel, was attentive and gave us good service. The restaurant’s dog, Honey, also came out to greet us and to receive a good petting. Recommended for those who prefer a quieter, hole-in-the-wall setting while still enjoying good food.
Location: 1, Jalan Kuala Teriang, Langkawi, Kedah

Review: What I'm about to tell you is not just a review. It's a kind beautiful inspiring story of what a human does for another, TODAY. …MoreWhat I'm about to tell you is not just a review. It's a kind beautiful inspiring story of what a human does for another, TODAY.8:15 pm: I was sick and looking for healthy, non greasy food. So I went to restaurant for some pumpkin soup, which was fabulous - infused with lemongrass and coconut milk.  Just as healthy and delicious, as I was looking for.Here what Soroya (might be mispelled) did:~8:30 pm: Before my soup was brought out, the owner noticed and asked if I was ill.  After a few more detailed questions, she suggested that I should hydrate with coconut water.~8:50: After I finished my soup, she told me to come back tomorrow to get the coconuts that she just asked her staff to get for me. I thanked her (a lot coz I can't walk further than 100m). Few minutes later she told me to wait, one of the staff (Mike) can run the scooter and get it now. It's about 9 p.m. at this point.Mike quickly rushed out and returned with a fresh young coconut with lots of water, that he particularly chose. I overheard that he had to instruct the coconut vendor not too cut open the coconut.  They were conscious with food safety, so Soroya cuts the coconut herself, with her chopper at the restaurant. (See attached picture)You can imagine how thankful I was to them at this point. I was grateful. On top of that, she didn't take my reimbursement for the coconut. I insisted, but she said, "I just want you to get better, it's on me."I'm touched! It's not the service, not the money, nothing.  No hidden agenda. Doing a good deed, without expecting anything in return. She just simply cared for another stranger! What a beautiful kind heart.PS:  I left out the details of how ill I was, because it's insignificant, so please don't trouble/expect similar treatments from the restaurant.It's a beautiful story that is needed to be heard

Author: Wei Chiang Lim

Author: Zippo Tan
Review: Hidden gems, love the environment, the service, and the foods, especially the signature platter. Highly recommended.
Location: Lot 2273 Kampung Tasek Anak, Jalan Pantai Tengah, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: JoFri

Author: Matt Yarema

Author: Joseph Jacob

Location: Lot 2273 Kampung Tasek Anak, Jalan Pantai Tengah, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Mun Kit Wong

Author: Claire Heywood

Author: Homa Ba

Author: Mandy Foo

Author: varnesh vnesh

Author: Sim ZK

Author: Krista Petkov

Location: Lot 2273 Kampung Tasek Anak, Jalan Pantai Tengah, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Lauren Benio

Author: Wesley Jellett

Author: Katy Benson

Author: Hayley Snaily

Author: N C

Most of the family enjoyed the nyonya food selection (this is what …MoreCame here with family over for dinner on the weekend away in Langkawi. Author: Merica Virta
Review: From hero to zeroWe used to love the food in this place and have visited twice in the past 1.5 …MoreFrom hero to zeroWe used to love the food in this place and have visited twice in the past 1.5 years while in Langkawi. This time we tried to book for a larger group in advance via whatsapp and their website but nobody ever answered.However today during the CNY when we brought our family (7 pax) the experience was so embarrassing and even offensive that I just can't imagine what an earth happened to them.Our ordering process was easy and smooth: 5/7 of the party ordered burgers, one the recommended celebrational fish and one rendang + a salad as an appetizer. We ordered a bottle of pinot gris but received a sauvignon blanc instead (no appologies, no recognition to customer that they were providing something else than what was ordered). However the wine was nice and we were okay with it, so let this one go.The burgers came with the salad and everyone enjoyed their food so far (except if my mother-in law who had a beetle under her burger and lost her appitite in the middle of her dinner). BUT then started the waiting for the two main course and after asking for them for two separate times (when the entire rest of the party had already finished eating and it had become a bit embarrassing already) I had to physically to go to the counter and ask for the ETA for the food (as it was already late and we didn't want to spend out whole night in there, but get kids to bed).THIS is where it got very interesting as when I asked after about our food as we had waited like a half an hour, asian looking (blonded hair) older lady just snapped back at me "which table are you??" (..like a customer would know their table number) and continued "the big table??".I immediately said, I don't feel it's fair that after all this waiting not a single soul has said sorry. Even one time. The lady had the nerve to shout at me that "you have ordered 20min ago! Not half an hour!" And just rushed to kitchen and left me stading there. The manner she was communicating was absolutely horrible and I couldn't even say a word to the male waitress after, I was just so astonished of the manner I had just been shouted at in a situation that THEY had screwed up.I took a seat in my table and the older asian lady comes to the table and screams again "you have waited for 20 minutes!" (Which is NOT TRUE. There had been over 20 minutes when the whole other party had received their main course) so I asked "so do you really think thats an appropriate time to wait?" In which she snapped "well this is the way we do things around here!" and left.No appologies, not a single ounce of caring about anything - just scolding the customer in front of the entire table of people.. I literally have nothing else to say that my fish which I FINALLY got was dry and over cooked and the beans around it were way too raw to eat so I had to leave them. The fish was also not seasoned properly but lets face it: On that point I just wanted to get away from the place, not even bothering to send the portion back as I felt so uneasy about the way I had just been scolded..I have to say I'm speechless. Horrible experience and also what on earth happened to the food? This used to be my favourite and now I can never imagine to return. EMBARRASSING.Edit//: STILL had uppset stomach FOUR days after this meal...

Author: Fann S
Review: I came here for what Fat Cupid seems to be known for -- Nyonya Laksa. And the verdict is that the restaurant delivers a solid laksa, especially with its broth, but leaves some to be desired. …MoreI came here for what Fat Cupid seems to be known for -- Nyonya Laksa. And the verdict is that the restaurant delivers a solid laksa, especially with its broth, but leaves some to be desired.Fat Cupid's version of Nyonya Laksa looks impressive when served. It came in huge bowl with generous portions of noodles. In the dish are long beans, bean sprouts, tau pok, one-half hard boiled egg, chicken pieces (I think they were breast meat), and a huge shrimp the size of an adult's palm.That said, Fat Cupid's version differs quite a bit from the conventional Nyonya version which doesn't include long beans or chicken pieces. I like the usual one with cockles, shrimp, tau pok, egg and lots of bean sprouts. I think the inclusion of cockles could go really well with the broth. I guess that's why I finished dinner a little underwhelmed after the huge hype of TripAdvisor. The long beans were also a little too raw to me, and bean sprouts too little.Still a good laksa (with an excellent broth) nonetheless but I wouldn't pay RM28 for it again. Service was excellent. The wait staff paid a lot of attention to the guests and offered citronella candles when he saw that we were getting stung by mozzies.
Location: Lot 2273 Kampung Tasek Anak, Jalan Pantai Tengah, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Vicariously Travelling
Review: We were very impressed with Thistday Bar at first glance. Staff are abundant and quick to serve, food is delicious, location is prime, and the entertainment is easily enjoyable. That's where it begins and ends. The staff maintain a pace of …MoreWe were very impressed with Thistday Bar at first glance. Staff are abundant and quick to serve, food is delicious, location is prime, and the entertainment is easily enjoyable. That's where it begins and ends. The staff maintain a pace of service that eventually becomes a little much especially when you want to take your time while dining here. If you want to wait to order food the staff will take your menu instead of leaving it for you to decide what you want to order. If you have a menu on your table they'll keep asking you if you're ready to order. Food and drinks arrive at your table at a lightning fast pace. They watch your every move to see if you have an empty plate or glass to be removed from your table and are ready to hand you your bill at moments notice. My wife and I were here celebrating the eve of her birthday. I asked several staff members in private, who were constantly swarming around our table, if I could order a dessert for her because it was her birthday and was told sorry kitchen is closed by all of them. I wasn't offered an alternative to order for the occasion, nor even offered a suggestion as I wanted to surprise her when the clock struck midnight. They all ignored my request as though they could care less and weren't even interested in helping me surprise her. I asked again if there was anything they could do for her birthday and they all ignored my question. When midnight arrived I wished her happy birthday, hugged and kissed her, and took selfies of the occasion as they all watched. They wouldn't even offer to take a picture for us even after they all heard me wish her a happy birthday. They all but ignored us during the moment and even walked away towards other tables. I'm extremely disappointed that we chose to celebrate the beginning of her birthday here. What was supposed to be a highlight of our honeymoon was ruined by their lack of compassion. A couple of days later we went to have dinner across the street at Three Amigos Mexican restaurant and, though it wasn't as crowded, the staff stopped the music and played a Happy Birthday song for one of their guests and their staff came out to clap and celebrate the occasion for them. Seeing this brought a somberness for both of us, as Three Amigos at least acknowledged the birthday of one of their guests. I hope this was an isolated moment with the staff of Thistday Bar because this place is really wonderful, they have great prices, great food, and I hate having to leave this kind of review for them. The pictures I've posted are the selfies I took to celebrate her birthday moment.
Location: Langkawi, Kedah

The rice that they serve comes in one big bowl. So you use a big ladle to take how much you want. We ordered 3 person's rice portion but it was more than the usual portion in other places. So we didn't finish the rice. I saw the other tables were the same. Most did not finish their rice as the serving was generous. However, all these unfinished rice will be put back into the big rice cooker, recycled for other customers. I found out because at the beginning I found a small leftover cooked chilli in my serving bowl. Then at the end of our meals I had the luxury of time so I was watching how a lady was clearing all the tables and she was the person in charge of recycling the rice bowls. I followed her movements right till the end ie, when I saw her dump the leftover rice back into the big rice cooker to be kept warm. Although people are suppose to use the big ladle to serve the rice, there is no stopping some people who will use their own eating spoon when they add more rice to their plate. Maybe that's how I had a small piece of chilli ended up in my serving bowl.I would give them a one star. But their service was top notch. So that's the only saving grace. Author: Cheong Xin Chi
Review: I spent Christmas evening here with my boyfriend, and we had the most splendid experience here. We found this place via recommendations on TripAdvisor but was slightly apprehensive initially as there weren't many reviews on Google. We were …MoreI spent Christmas evening here with my boyfriend, and we had the most splendid experience here. We found this place via recommendations on TripAdvisor but was slightly apprehensive initially as there weren't many reviews on Google. We were not let down at all. Firstly, the ambience takes the cake - it was relaxed, romantic and comfortable. It was set against a scenic setting, and had very Balinese vibes almost. The restaurant also had many cats, but they're friendly and tame. Secondly, the food was delicious. We ordered the seafood platter (?) and the fried calamari for starters, the prawn curry and the fish with mashed potatoes for mains, and the Gula Melaka ice cream and cinnamon cheesecake for desserts. No complaints here, although the prices are on the high side. Granted, you pay for what you get. And that's quality dining experience, second to none in Langkawi. Finally, the service was excellent. We felt very welcomed and comfortable the second we stepped in. Our needs were met at any point, and we never felt rushed to leave, although we were the last diners and they were about to close. This was an exceptional experience for us and we would definitely be coming back if we find ourselves in Langkawi next time.
Location: Bon Ton Restaurant and Resort, Laman Padi Langkawi,, Jalan Pantai Cenang, Langkawi, Kedah

The wine was opened clumsily (though it was great!). When our mains showed up, the staff was confused about who had ordered what. One of the mains did not show up, and again we had to inquire about it. It did show up a few minutes later.As we were having our meal, a waiter came by offering to top up our water from a carafe despite there being a bottle of mineral water on the table. We were not offered the option of filtered water, and at one point the same waiter topped up one of our waters with the filtered water.When it came time to pay, we had to eventually again get the waiters' attention. After we got our bill we had to go up to the staff to get them to actually charge our credit card.Overall a delicious meal - but the service left much to be desired given the property!

Author: AnimalMusic
Review: Lovely atmosphere... Brilliantly located restaurant nestled beautifully within the grounds of the entrance of the 99 East golf course with uninterrupted view of the sea. …MoreLovely atmosphere... Brilliantly located restaurant nestled beautifully within the grounds of the entrance of the 99 East golf course with uninterrupted view of the sea.It is managed by a proffesional host/owner backed by a team of polite/attentive and efficient staff. Cleanliness is something you won't be disappointed with here as with the overall service.You can see the owner has put a lot of thought into the menu with high quality ingredients catering to a wide selection of diners.  It has a good choice of vegetarian, vegan options clearly marked on the menu from starters to mains. Bearing in mind the food is home cooked ( there isnt a 20 page menu 🤔which is quite often a good sign) made from fresh ingredients and there is even a daily specials which brings you back for more 😁Family friendly if you have children or toddlers as it has been laid out in such a way that you have a piece of mind when your little ones might want to "explore " as parents would normally experience.It has got tables for different group sizes as I noticed seems sensible for party size booking or special occasions I guess.Great length are made in the shop to sell/promote high quality local goods ethically sourced which is a fresh approach  to a sustainable business model.Perhaps the only thing I would like to say is maybe the spice level could go up a few notch for the rendang tempeh dish.... But I might be biased here.. As I like'em hot 🔥We enjoyed the overall experience and atmosphere here. We regularly visit the place and would recommend it to anyone with Western and local dishes made with care.😂

The food at Orkid Ria is not bad but aimed for the larger crowds thus a bit bland. Perfect for first-time tourists or for those who have a particular dislike for very spicy food.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Jason Foo
Review: Must be there early. Long queue after 7pm. Nice food with good service.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Ooi SB
Review: Excellent service! More so on their food. Fish is super fresh, if you can't find your selection on the spread, you may select from their tanks and they will be more than happy to catch live fish of you choice at a small extra charge.. …MoreExcellent service! More so on their food. Fish is super fresh, if you can't find your selection on the spread, you may select from their tanks and they will be more than happy to catch live fish of you choice at a small extra charge..6 adults and 1 kid total up to RM337 only. Tiger prawns, very fresh steamed fish, fried soft shell crabs, fried squids, satay, salted fish Kailan and seafood Tom yum.Go early else you'll have to queue. Value for money and great family restaurant! Will definitely return for more!
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: meor hafizan
Review: Delicious food and awesome service!
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Robert Dahlström
Review: For me this place is a bit overrated. It's quite noisy and I think you can get good seafood in many other places, that's not that expensive. The fish we ordered were so and so. The ginger fish tasted good, but the grilled one was not seasoned at all, so that was not that great.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Kate Reuvers
Review: My friend loves seafood and is Malaysian and thought this was great. Her favourite was the cung Kong. I am vegetarian so wasn’t my favourite, as most dishes that appeared vegetarian had shrimp. Which I don’t like (Altho they had a great …MoreMy friend loves seafood and is Malaysian and thought this was great. Her favourite was the cung Kong. I am vegetarian so wasn’t my favourite, as most dishes that appeared vegetarian had shrimp. Which I don’t like (Altho they had a great bean curd dish with no shrimp). If you’re after seafood, go here! Given 4 stars based on my friends recommendation as she’s not a review writer, but loves seafood.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Douaa Saeed
Review: It's amazing food!! I asked for super spicy food (all my dishes were super spicy) (I am a spicy lover). The waiter expressed his concern about internationals not being able to handle spicy food and complaining before but I assured him I'm …MoreIt's amazing food!! I asked for super spicy food (all my dishes were super spicy) (I am a spicy lover). The waiter expressed his concern about internationals not being able to handle spicy food and complaining before but I assured him I'm up for it (really love spicy) and the food was amazing. Not only spicy but jam packed with flavour!!Definitely will visit again in langkawi.Moreover the owner was there assuring everyone's order was okey. Kudos to my waiter and him!
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Ivana Bolton
Review: Sea food is fresh as it can be since you can choose fish you want from tank and they will prepare it for you BUT grill fish is not actually grilled its made on hot plate so i get oily bland dead fish no taste at all not even salt on it. So …MoreSea food is fresh as it can be since you can choose fish you want from tank and they will prepare it for you BUT grill fish is not actually grilled its made on hot plate so i get oily bland dead fish no taste at all not even salt on it. Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Kah Yi
Review: Great place for seafood at the Cenang Walk/near the Cenang Beach. Must go during lunch or before 6pm. The staffs are helpful. When picking live seafood, the staffs help you choose, weigh the pick in front of you, tell you the price immediately, all very transparent. Choices were great. The restaurant is windy.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Nabilla S
Review: There seems to be a segregation of nationalities when it comes to being seated at this restaurant - with the foreigners being placed at the nicer part of the restaurant and the locals shoved closer to where the fish tanks and kitchen is. …MoreThere seems to be a segregation of nationalities when it comes to being seated at this restaurant - with the foreigners being placed at the nicer part of the restaurant and the locals shoved closer to where the fish tanks and kitchen is. Perhaps it was just my imagination. In any case, the price for their crabs and shellfish here is a little steep (as compared to other busier and better places like Wonderland foodstore). The only good thing? The sauce of their chilli crab is like no other I’ve tried before.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Chris WooCH
Review: We only try fresh oyster here and I think it was cozy.But the oyster is fresh.Service average since they having a high incoming of guest. …MoreWe only try fresh oyster here and I think it was cozy.But the oyster is fresh.Service average since they having a high incoming of guest.We order 1 fried glass noodle(S),  1 medium  fried rice ,1 Tom yum soup , 3 glass of juice and 2pcs oyster cost us about Rm70+-.If u looking for a affordable seafood price  this is not the one.some of the seafood we like to eat like la-la, and other more cheaper seafood they do not serve .They only serve expensive seafood.But overall ok.Nothing out of expectations except the prices. Next time if come back I would try they seafood dishes.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: LYNN SWART
Review: The food cannot be any better, absolutely superb! The service was excellent,  waiters are very attentive. The prices are not expensive at all. Will definitely return to try something else on the menu
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Charlotte Château Thierry
Review: The food was tasty.There is so many people and it's hard to find a table.It's good place to have a good dish and in the same time enjoy the music. …MoreThe food was tasty.There is so many people and it's hard to find a table.It's good place to have a good dish and in the same time enjoy the music.I had singapore noodles...tastyEnjoy your meal !
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Pavel Cherepansky
Review: Tiger prawn was overcooked and dry, sauce was all right. Snapper was presented beautifully, but very hard to eat and very simple in taste. Rice was fine though and beer was $2 for a pint of Tiger, so it has that going for it. $80 lobster is just ridiculous on the other hand.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Roel Janssen
Review: Be prepared to wait in line for your table. This is a crowded restaurant that serves fresh seafood and traditional Chinese dishes. Pick your own dinner from the fish tanks at the entrance. Prices are very reasonable and staff is friendly. Getting your bill might take a little longer than you are used to.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Avinash Advani
Review: Absolutely the best seafood in Langkawi. You can choose from live lobsters, fishes crabs and choose your sauce and the cooking style. The ABC sauce on the fishes is my favourite. Service is fast efficient and friend friendly. Be ready to wait a while for dinners as it's always crowded.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: YiK Jia Tan
Review: The food is expensive side for Malaysian. Taste wise is more suitable for foreigner, a bit too bland. Not suitable for local people. Long queue, mostly are tourist. There is better restaurant around if you can travel far from Cenang beach
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: AN AR
Review: It was just OK. Didn't order any of the expensive seafood like crab, lobster or tiger prawn. Settled for butter prawn which was good, steam ginger seabass also good, omelette and chicken cashew not so good. Waiting time around 20 30 min. …MoreIt was just OK. Didn't order any of the expensive seafood like crab, lobster or tiger prawn. Settled for butter prawn which was good, steam ginger seabass also good, omelette and chicken cashew not so good. Waiting time around 20 30 min. Which OK for me since it was peak hours. Go sumwhere else for seafood. I figured must be sumwhere cheaper and nicer. Not hard to beat this above average seafood.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Glamgoat Aman Dusun
Review: I was surprised to see the food was prepared by bangladeshi ( not chinese cook). The food was blend and tasteless. The pomfret smells fishy ( not fresh), even simple fried chilly chicken was prepared badly. Maybe this restaurant is meant for tourist only but for locals not recommended at all.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Hwee Guan Teh (Wayne)
Review: Prices are fairly reasonable, given the location being a tourist area. The fish (white pomfret) was not fresh though. Our visit was 14.10.19 for dinner. The crabs was okay.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Joel Lee
Review: A restaurant past its prime.The “Butter prawns” were bland and tasteless and were clearly not fresh.The fish was good as it was chosen from the front of the stall. …MoreA restaurant past its prime.The “Butter prawns” were bland and tasteless and were clearly not fresh.The fish was good as it was chosen from the front of the stall.Sambal kang kong was good as well.Foo yong egg is normal.However... it is still the most famous restaurant along Cenang Beach.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Ah Q
Review: Fresh seafoodWe ordered a live red snapper, 3 super sized king prawns, 3 bbq oysters, some veg and a bee hoon. Only 2 of us and we struggle to finish. The prawns were …MoreFresh seafoodWe ordered a live red snapper, 3 super sized king prawns, 3 bbq oysters, some veg and a bee hoon. Only 2 of us and we struggle to finish. Once u hv selected your victim at the tank, they will weigh your meal and advise you of the price upfront.Ambience wise, nice deco, no aircond.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Sheena Pimentel
Review: Good food, fast service and it’s along Pantai Cenang so no need to pay for transportation.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Joshua Chin
Review: Seafood here is good! Had the fish, scallops, butter prawns and oyster omelette, and the seafood was fresh and cooking style nothing short of awesome. Can explain why there's a long line usually too.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Hau Eng Moo
Review: Was here on a weekday noon so there wasn't much crowd. Service was great, food were served quick and taste good.Only comment: Cashew chicken was full of veges and hardly find any chicken cube inside.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Yin Lam (Emily)
Review: I see there are lots of reviews about this restaurant but do think they were much much overrated.  I spent more than MYR100 for a dish of 3 tiger shrimps which were not live but frozen and it was tasteless!  Besides, if you are Chinese, please do not order soups and it is just salty water!
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Mark Warren
Review: Loved the food, loved the service.. Loved the fact that they confirm certain prices before they proceeded to cook.. (example:ordered tiger prawn, the waitress brought the uncooked prawn and showed us the condition and the price before proceeding with cooking it)
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Vidula Nandasena
Review: Really good food. The seafood nasi goreng is the best around in the area.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Nikola Dušková
Review: Busy place but quick service! If you want to eat seafood or fish, you can choose it. I tried fried rice, oyster omelette, fish, mix vegetable, chicken, fried prawn and ice lemon tea. Really delicious meal! Price is higher but you are in touristic centre near Cenang beach so it is normal.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Juan Wei
Review: Decently wide selection of seafood. Located at roughly the beginning of Cenang beach stretch. Food served very quickly when we were there. Restaurant looks clean and well kept. Can view live seafood such as huge lobsters, saltwater fish, …MoreDecently wide selection of seafood. Located at roughly the beginning of Cenang beach stretch. Food served very quickly when we were there. Restaurant looks clean and well kept. Can view live seafood such as huge lobsters, saltwater fish, etc at the entrance and fish tanks looks clean. Felt the serving sizes a bit on the small side though.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Adam Fulford
Review: Food was ok, nothing to write home about. Go to the back of the restaurant and check out the view of the beach. Prices were reasonable for what you got. Service wasn’t slow nor fast and waiters were attentive. Menu is large so you will probably find something to eat.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Brandon Wong
Review: Best seafood in Cenang Beach. Must try.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Satyaraj Muniandy
Review: Super delicious food!
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Hayward Ng
Review: Reasonable price and good seafood.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: viceroy7180
Review: Had a fresh live grilled lobster at Orkid, would recommend other methods of cooking as the lobster was overcooked and a bit rubbery making it hard to chew. They cooked the head in porridge which was fantastic. Enjoyed the porridge more than the actual lobster.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Akhilesh Kumar
Review: staff is good and food is average expensive you can easily afford
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Mun Meng Tham

If you order seafoods (crab, lobster and fish), you can choose your own preference (freshness, size, weight).2. If you order a fresh fish, always choose steam as the cooking method. Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Eunice Tan
Review: Frankly speaking this place is overrated. Please check your dish properly before you have it. We ordered crab , they weighted a complete crab but when the dish arrive it become lesser than what we choose and weight before. When we feedback to the staff but they just ignore it.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Shibli Sattar
Review: We were looking for some seafood and also halal and came across this place near our hotel. We ordered the fried sea bass, fried rice and fried greens amd the food was great. Gets busy so bit of a queue but worth the wait if your not in a hurry. Will go again.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Mark Botten
Review: Our first time in Langkawi and Orkid Ria was recommended to us by friends in Australia. Author: Wilson Wong
Review: Night time it's buzzling with activities. Front half of menu booklet has each dish by price and size, and quite reasonably priced. Later half has the more attractive premium seafood with no prices indicated, probably fluctuating daily
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Duc Ngo
Review: Have dinner at this restaurant twice while I was in Lang Kawi. The quality of food is great and price range is acceptable. We pay 240MYR for a meal of 4 adults and one child., including seafood. highly recommend!!!
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: John Sifonios
Review: Nice place, quick service but grill not good. I had a live tiger grouper approx 900gr, it was one side burned and other side not cooked. What a waste of a fish.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: HL Ong
Review: Very professional waiters. Food was good and the ingredients (seafood) are fresh.... only if you pick the live ones. Else, order the shrimps and scallops and expect to be served frozen goods.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Rizky Triyono
Review: All the food I oredered were delicious. Service was fast but in my experience, the rice came 5 minutes after all the dishes have arrived which is what making me rating it 4 stars. Overall, the food is very tasty and worth a visit
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Arul Lakshmanan
Review: Have to wait in queue to get the seats. We can select the live fish, prawn, lobster and get them cooked. Seafood is bit overpriced. Taste is good. A must try place when you are in cenang beach.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: A AHMED
Review: Today 2 nd time here lovely foodexcellent service
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Lewis Lau
Review: Great food, great service, good price!  Sea food is fresh and reasonably priced! Service is great and they even stopped me ordering too much! Already thinking what to order the next time we go back!
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Anubhav Gandhi
Review: We've always had sea food only here in Langkawi so I don't have anything to compare it with but in isolation, the food is incredible here. The steamed fish in specific is one of the best that you can find.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Dr Siddharth Kumar
Review: Great food, value for money. Fresh seafood, coconut ice cream mind blowing!! A bit crowded might have to wait a while. But its worth the wait!
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Muneeb Iqbal
Review: Food is good but the service is poor. Orkid Ria appears to be closed and customers are being served in the same location by 'Thirstday Bar and Grill'. I guess it has has been renamed.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Yusril Maulidan Raji
Review: Very recommended. Affordable price. It seems the price is expensive for some menus in the beginning. But when the meals came, it was worth it both for the the portion and taste. I suggest to just buy the Small portion, because it can be for 3-4 people.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: lilyy
Review: Very delicious local authentic food. They served different kinds of seafood with different types of cooking methods. Do get brave and try every flavor, it’s nice.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Heidi Meisaari
Review: The food was so good!! The best seafood in cenang! The place was full of people but they had enough stuff to handle it. The food is so fresh and it came fast. We were there 3 times during a week. Highly rekommend!
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Desiree Sommerfeld
Review: Fast fresh authentic and great taste. Only one washroom per gender though and very basic. Otherwise amazing. Tiger prawns and lobster my favorite. Try fried rice for sure
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Jeremy S
Review: Extremely disappointing and overpriced. The fish is fresh, but cooking is mediocre. The rice is an insult to rice. Noodle dish was drowning in soya sauce. Vegetables cooked to death. For the prices they charge they should be ashamed to serve such poorly cooked food.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: alain haberstich
Review: What can go wrong with ordering tofu? right, not really anything.If it comes to seafood, that's a whole other story!Even though the restaurant calls itself "seafood restaurant" does not mean it's …MoreWhat can go wrong with ordering tofu? right, not really anything.If it comes to seafood, that's a whole other story!Even though the restaurant calls itself "seafood restaurant" does not mean it's good.I can appriciate that they focus theire dishes on Tiger Prawns and Lobster... therefore it's even sader to realize the dishes seem not be made to order.Our grilled Tiger Prawns and half a duck arrived with incredible speed - therefore due to lack of quality.The 'duck thai style' csme with a storebought sweet-sour-chilli sauce. other than that it was nice.The 3 Tiger prawns, in price more than double the half duck, arrived at the table at the same time... only half warm. dry. and even a bit chewy. it's so sad to have such incredible ingredients, and then to spoil it.prawns can be so nice, juicy, deliciuos. however - not here!Conclusion: Don't waste your money on BADLY prepared seafood here!
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: László J
Review: This is a well maintained & clean restaurant, the staff is kindly and helpful. The serving was fast and the food was delicious. Even though not that fancy and attractive, but still, there are cheaper alternates with the same quality …MoreThis is a well maintained & clean restaurant, the staff is kindly and helpful. The serving was fast and the food was delicious. Even though not that fancy and attractive, but still, there are cheaper alternates with the same quality available nearby. Overall it is a nice place, but I would rather recommend other options with more reasonable prices especially for budget conscious customer.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: XY Yeo
Review: 125rm for a dinner for 3, consisting of mock sharks fin soup, satay, steamed fish, fried vege and drinks. Taste was good and staff were friendly. Definitely worth a visit.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Toronyi Ferenc
Review: From the Street easy to find it, from the beach behind the Thirstday Bar and Restaurant. Owner is the same family. We can recommend it for everyone. Orkid more family restaurant Thirstday more quaility more romantic, different type of food, but both of them amazing! Staff very friendly, food is amazing.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Kun-Mao Chen
Review: Fresh shrimp seafood shop.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Simeon Hinov
Review: Very popular place for no reason. Food is mediocre and bland, live selection is limited to grouper ($30 per kg) , lobsters and mussels. Food is mediocre and bland, live selection is limited to grouper ($30 per kg) , lobsters and mussels. Ordered sea bass from the fresh fish ($10) for 500 grams, (also red snapper available), grilled. There is no ambience, a bit shabby and sweaty place.

Author: Steve W
Review: Orkid Ria Seafood Restaurant is centrally locates just off the beach behind Thirstdays. The food is super tasty and has a busy local vibe. Definitely worth a visit if you’re in the area.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: JY Tan
Review: Reasonable price and seafood was fresh. Grill seabass and soft shell crab is highly recomended. Can be crowded and waiting is needed but one of the more popular seafood restaurant in Pantai Cenang.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Nawarat Ailuan
Review: I came here because of the review but food is not as great as i thought it would be. A bit bland too my taste. More suitable for tourists who don't like much flavours. Price is reasonable and restaurant is big and clean
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: helmi mohd nor
Review: The place was great for small or large group. Selection of seafood is amazing. Maybe a bit of queing time on peak hour. Though there maybe be hit and misses on the cooked food depending on your tastebuds. Parking is a challenge.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Ah Kit
Review: Very delicious local authentic food. They served different kinds of seafood with different types of cooking methods. Do get brave and try every flavor, it’s nice.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Jixsy Hanni
Review: Price reflects good quality of food and services. Food really  tasty recommended for couple and group of friends and families who are looking for good tasty fresh food.clean open air environment. By the beach
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Andy Lim
Review: Always crowded,  seafood is fresh with variety of choices.
Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Josi Chiang
Review: Fresh seafood of choice! The seafood is nice - you can pick, and then they will cook it for you as you like. The fried butter tiger prawns are delicious! …MoreFresh seafood of choice! Location: Lot 1225, Pantai Cenang, Mukim Kedawang, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: maria quek

Author: Jean Francoise Ng Lewis
Review: Great food. We had hoped to try the lobster but it was double the price of other restaurants but that made us try other things on the menu and we were not disappointed . Every thing we ordered was delicious.

Author: SD C
Review: I had high hopes for this place after reading a bunch of good reviews but man was I disappointed - it was probably one of THEE worst meal in my entire Langkawi vacation. I get why it's popular - it does have a pretty scenic view of the …MoreI had high hopes for this place after reading a bunch of good reviews but man was I disappointed - it was probably one of THEE worst meal in my entire Langkawi vacation. I get why it's popular - it does have a pretty scenic view of the 'kampung' life, of paddy fields and Langkawi's mountains in the backdrop - but take that out of the equation, and what's left is food that is mediocre at best - and that's saying a lot.We were looking forward to simple nasi dagang, and we knew that it's not fancy food but upon arrival, we were pretty horrified to see that not a single person from their kitchen staff was following any COVID protocols and this really put a dent on our experience here. No one was wearing a mask, and those who had a mask, had it under their chins. As we ordered our food, a few of them were standing next to each other chatting away, preparing the exposed food and drinks that's being served to customers. We did our best to give them the benefit of the doubt and focus on the food but that was disappointing too. Rice with a tiny portion of curry (we had the beef and fish ones), but we were told that they ran out of vegetables so we literally were served just rice and curry, got ourselves 2 teh O ais (unsweet iced teas), and managed to snag some of their remaining kuihs (one banana and one savory - cekodok pisang and some kind of cucur, was our guess). We stared at our order in disbelief - it was beyond depressing. There's simple decent food, and there's simple and amazingly tasty food. Unfortunately, this was neither. Food was bland, curry is no better than ones found at random roadside stalls or warungs anywhere in Malaysia. Completely not worth the drive or the visit during your Langkawi visit.During our meal, we continued to witness instances of staff clearing tables and chatting with one another and with customers as if COVID did not exist in Langkawi at this time. Upon payment, our measly nasi dagang (or should I say, prison food of rice and curry), 2 teh O ais, and 2 kuihs ended up costing RM 26. You be the judge of that price. Perhaps this place should be called "Nasi Dagang Pak MAHAL". Disappointed, we decided that honest feedback while we were there was the best thing we could do and told/asked the cashier lady (who wasn't masked) that we were not happy with our meal but more importantly, if they realized that COVID was still a real thing and that they needed to follow the SOPs - all we got was a "ya" and a smile. The gal didn't even bother to put on her mask that was hanging on her chin as we spoke. At this point, we couldn't care less about this experience any longer and wanted nothing but to leave.Look, it is my principle as a Google Guide to give credit where credit is due, and tell it like it is. I hate bashing small businesses but in this case, the only positive I could find is the scenery. It really made us rethink our choice of dining at this popular nasi dagang place and we questioned the overall cleanliness and hygiene. The lack of care for their customers during this pandemic is disappointing - not even the scenic views of paddy fields and their mediocre food could fix this horrible dining experience. Unfortunately, I would not and can not recommend this place to anyone unless you want to be ripped off by a tourist trap. We will not be returning for sure.
Location: Jalan Makam Mahsuri, Kampung Mawar, Langkawi, Kedah

My husband and I found him very …MoreThe food is tasty, so tasty that we will be going back there to pack for our parents back in kl before we leave. Pak Malau who is the owner is such a sweet man with a few magic tricks up his sleeves too. My husband and I found him very entertaining. The staffs are friendly too. The place is clean and I did not spot any flies. Perhaps those flies were not in season!!  The view of the paddy field and mountain is breathtaking. It was breezy when I was there too.They serve Nasi Dagang which is actually a Kelantanese dish. The rice goes with fish, chicken or beef. I like the daging kerutuk best. On Friday's they serve goat meat. There are a good selection of Malay kueh too. My favourite is the kueh lompang and Pau...yummy. Other kueh offered are pulut panggang, cucur kodok, kueh lapis, donut and a few more which I cannot remember 🤔Each Nasi Dagang cost RM10. The ayam kampung is RM12 whilst the goat meat is RM16. It is reasonable for the view, ambience, taste, cleanliness and the ever entertaining Pak Malau.
Location: Jalan Makam Mahsuri, Kampung Mawar, Langkawi, Kedah

Review: Love this place - great view and great food. We went here a couple of times while in Langkawi. We went here a couple of times while in Langkawi. First you have to love the atmosphere - looks out over a beautiful beach and the ocean (also great to watch sunset from here). The service was pretty good, but not great - have to find somebody one time. We love the food however. The flavors were great and the portions were good. The prices are a bit high for some things, but reasonable for many. We tried a smoked salmon on farmers bread (37 MYR), a Ketam Lembut (26 MYR - fried rice with soft shell crab), a Masam Manis (48 MYR - spicy chicken dish), Phad Thai (26 MYR), Mannara Oceano (34 MYR). Tiger beer was 9 MYR, Cosmopolitan was 20 MYR, and Ice Lemon Tea was 15 MYR. All of the food was spectacular.

The bar next door has a wide range of drinks on offer and is a great spot for some people watching or water sport viewing before dinner. We got the seafood platter which was huge for 2 people but allowed us to taste all the delicious varieties on offer. It’s pretty expensive compared to other places you can go around Langkawi but very affordable compared to getting this in Aus so we were happy to splurge. The water is as expensive as a pint of beer though and they will give you the most expensive one on the menu, but given they didn’t charge a service fee, it evens out. A good night out if you’re looking for some good seafood and a bit of an indulgent meal.

We were served by a different person each time, and it went from being chaotic to just totally ignoring us. About 3 different people tried to take our order. We were told that what we wanted was sold out, along with several of other dishes (at 7.30 on a Sunday. Noone came to offer more drinks (we'd run out before the food even arrived). It was impossible to get more drinks as staff stood around on their phones, pointedly ignoring us.The food itself wasn't great. The menu is limited and not particularly Malaysian. It's basically fish with a token few Thai-style meat options.The fish was ok, but the beef with Thai basil didn't actually contain any Thai basil. It was just beef in a plain unseasoned gravy, as if a bit of water and flour had been added to the pan it was fried in.Note that the food prices are basically Western prices - just under £50 for two starters, two mains and one cocktails. It's not cheap and you need "sides" (rice, veg) with most dishes.The water is also a farce.I think it's absolutely disgusting that if you ask for bottled water, you'll get given imported European bottled water. You have to explicitly ask for Malaysian mineral water. It's absurd to import *water* from the other side of the planet when theres plenty of natural Malaysian mineral water.It's nice having a sea view, but the walls around the restaurant are high so you can't see the view from the table unless you're quite tall/sit up really really straight. Cannot praise them enough! The owner had a quick chat with us after the meal and thanked us for coming.Cleanliness: beautiful and clean the restaurant had a well maintained European toilet. Inside beautiful decorated with modern decorAmbience: we visited at 8:30 on a Thursday night and were the only dinners until we left when two more groups came in. We enjoyed a nice and quiet romantic meal as the only guests.Definitely worth a visit on your Langkawi trip be it for lunch or dinner you won’t be disappointed!

Author: Serafina Lim
Review: hi! :)i'm not usually the type of person to send reviews to any restaurant, but this …Morehi! :)i'm not usually the type of person to send reviews to any restaurant, but this one in particular was so... interesting that i just had to.PROS:- the food is great! there is a decent variety of tapas available.- the location is also great! its located nearby the beaches, where you can get the occasional breeze.CONS:where do we begin...- the service is, frankly speaking, terrible. my family and i arrived at the restaurant at about 6pm. there were barely any people in the restaurant so we were hoping to quickly get our food. imagine to our surprise that we had to wait a whopping 3 hours for our food to arrive! sure, the food was good and all, but that unfortunately doesn't excuse us waiting 3 hours for it to arrive. remember, there were barely any people in the restaurant when we first came.- the food is heavily overpriced. i would slightly understand if its to get money from tourists and all, but unfortunately its covid season. this especially applies to the paella. it costed us a whopping rm118 for it, and was barely enough to feed us. there are other places elsewhere you could get less expensive food and still have the same quality (or even better) than Tapaz.- the owner. i have seen reviews about the owner on google but told myself to come with an open, non judgemental mind. he would prefer to prioritise the livelihoods and experiences of the foreigners than entertain the locals. they sat down later than us, but were treated with their main courses and their tapas first. would this be racial discrimination? perhaps. after we were done with the food, my mother went to talk to the owner about the service. she talked about how the food took so long, and how the service was bad. he sarcastically responded with "if you want your food early you should have ordered in advance." and "we are understaffed.". should we have known that there was an option to order in advance we would have done so, instead of waiting 3 hours for our food. maybe update your Facebook page to have that option instead? my family and I came here approximately one year ago and we were still treated with late food and the "understaffed" situation. it's been a year. has there truly been no one wanting to work or is it you? The pricing of the food was not the cheapest but worth the price.

Review: A true authentic Negeri Sembilan dining experience in Langkawi. It is cooked by the NS family themselves. Masak Lemak Cili Api or roughly translated Yellow Chilli Gravy is a traditional yet commercial local food in Peninsula. It is a main …MoreA true authentic Negeri Sembilan dining experience in Langkawi. It is cooked by the NS family themselves. Masak Lemak Cili Api or roughly translated Yellow Chilli Gravy is a traditional yet commercial local food in Peninsula. It is a main dish (usually cooked for lunch) prepared with herbs and spices, coconut milk, turmeric powder and grilled red/green chillies. The more coconut mill and chillies the better. What make it so different is the level degree of meeting the true standard of cooking. Most commercial restaurant will cook it out of business (the gravy is watery and tasteless, some with little taste and less spicey). However, a genuine NS vendors will cook the gravy exactly as thick and spicey as it should be. Extremely satisfied! Although - it is expensive! Very expensive. For 5 pax, it can cost you over RM100, if you add seafood, especially tiger prawn in the gravy. Nevertheless, I definitely will be back, again!

What a find on my first night at Tengah, on Langkawi! Came to Langkawi for New Years Eve and I stumbled upon the tiny bar right outside this restaurant and the bar owner, Lan, suggested I try it out. I had a chicken in curry sauce (I forget the exact name but it’s the house special) that was so good I ordered a second entree, the Calamari Sambal. It was pretty spicy and ridiculously good. I came back the next night for prawns. The owner Ri Ri just opened up a few weeks ago. The place is very unassuming and still a work in progress but these were some of the best meals I have had in years. Very high quality ingredients with really nice people! I was so happy with this place!

Offers tour packages around island.We came back for a second visit because our first was truly enjoyable.First visit: We were skeptical before we entered the restaurant because it was empty. But it was 9pm. It turned out they were very busy that evening, just that we were their last customers for that night. We ordered Chilli Crab & Black Pepper Crab. The Chilli Crab sauce tasted more like sweet sour sauce, but crabmeat from both dishes were fresh. Black Pepper crab was delicious. We also ordered black pepper beef, salted egg chicken wings, stir fried tou miao, stir fried kai lan and mango chicken. Every dish, other than the mango chicken, was heaven. We felt we were in food paradise. Good food makes one happy! It was our first night of arrival in Langkawi, thus this restaurant set the benchmark for the rest of our 9-day stay here. The mango chicken was mediocre. The staff were very warm, attentive and friendly, they were helpful in making food recommendations. We felt embarrassed when we found out that they were waiting for us to finish our food (crab dishes) before they could close shop for the day. But they were so kind and told us to enjoy our meal slowly. Bonus point! Total bill was RM504 (most dishes were large orders), it was completely worth it. The remarkable part is, none of us felt thirsty a few hours after the scrumptious meal, which is quite typical after most restaurant food where they add MSG to enhance the taste. Another Bonus point!Second visit: I was already craving to return the second night for dinner, but we decided on other food choices. On our third night, we returned with a very warm welcome. The staff greeted us cheerfully and commented they haven't seen us for 2 days. This time, we ordered spring rolls (yummy!), Singapore fried bee hoon (delicious!), crispy noodles (good!) and Hong Kong style grouper (tasty!). We repeated our first night's order of black pepper beef, salted egg chicken wings, stir fried kai lan and tou miao. Not surprisingly, they brought us to food heaven again. It was another wonderful dine-in experience! The bill came up to RM284 this time.Third visit: ordered black pepper beef (2x), fried spring rolls (2x), salted egg chicken wings, Singapore noodles (which was too salty, we got a refund) & drinks. Bill total RM209.Look for the boss, Qiang Shifu. He got us really great value deals. For example:1) Parasailing (from the beach) costs normally RM120 per person, we paid RM60 instead.2) Island Hopping (2 islands) 3.5 hours for RM280, whole boat for ourselves (6-8 people). Normally RM300-350.3) Pulau Payar snorkeling day trip RM240/adult (normal RM250-300). Includes pick up/drop off from hotel, ferry ride, snorkeling, buffet lunch.

Author: Bao zizi
Review: Just across the busy street of Jalan Pantai Chenang from the Langkawi Underwater World in Cenang Beach (which is the centre of tourist attraction in Langkawi) is this little, unassuming Chinese seafood restaurant at the corner of the …MoreJust across the busy street of Jalan Pantai Chenang from the Langkawi Underwater World in Cenang Beach (which is the centre of tourist attraction in Langkawi) is this little, unassuming Chinese seafood restaurant at the corner of the street. It not only lacks the grandeur and splendour of its more illustrious competitor, Orkid Ria Seafood Restuarant, it offers little by way of cozy and relaxing ambience nor does it have scenic beach view. However, it does have very fresh and sumptuous seafood which is of much better value than Orkid Ria's! Hence, it's in every diner's best interest to check this one out simply because the number of decent seafood restaurants in Langkawi are few and far between as fish and shellfish as seafood, are not usually caught in the waters of Langkawi. Instead, most good restaurants have their seafood stock sourced from the neighboring state of Perak and Sabah!Before moving on and to move the FAQ of halal food out of the way: there is this local municipal decree in Langkawi Island that dictates food sold and served in Pantai Cenang be pork-free...You have a choice of freshly cleaned up seafood or live seafood available for your selection at this little restaurant of about 10 tables that cater to small entourage of tourists or walk in diners, where two or three commercial weighing scales are on full display on a table at the entrance just to assure that you're able to gain a sense of the final billing amount. That's a fair game to many tourists. Live lobsters, clams, tiger prawns, Sri Lankan crabs, grouper fish of the exotic variety including both the "tiger" aka 老虎班 (dark brown patches with stripes on its body) and "dragon-tiger" aka 龙虎班 (completely black in colour) as well as Marble Goby (筍壳) await your gastronomic decision making. Scoop your choice of live seafood out of the tank and let Qiang Shifu (Master Chef Qiang, in Mandarin) take over from there! If you are in a hurry but expect very decently prepared seafood for your enjoyment, the freshly cleaned seafood of fish or dressed lobster on display on the ice block should be your choice in order to keep the turnaround time down to about 15mins!The signature dish for fish lover is an exotic steamed Chinese pickle (腌菜清蒸) style of preparation for grouper which to some, may just be a tad too sweet. But as a seafood lover, I personally appreciate this specialty of Mr. Qiang Sifu. Else, go for the ever revered and time-tested soy-sauce steamed grouper or Marble Goby down to the "Goldilock standard" as an over-cooked grouper or Goby would do diners little justice, which is so often the case in many Chinese seafood restaurants in the Klang Valley.Other mouthwatering seafood dishes include the handpicked, dressed grilled lobster arranged in its natural shell; charcoal grilled or steamed giant crab and grilled butter prawn (200-250g size) which are truly succulent and with its natural flavour and texture well retained! If you like some dishes more "soupy", choose the ever popular chilli-sauce crab, but my fav remains their grilled butter prawn and black pepper crab.For some reasons, I have not found a seafood restaurant that is able to cook clam or 'lala' well so it comes as no surprise that this seafood is low on my recommendation list. As for veg lovers, their fried "kangkong belacan" (water spinach) is a must try, as it's cooked with the right degree of spiciness and texture of dried krill with garlic : good "wokhei" (in the Cantonese dialect) is the right term to describe it!  Alternately, choose their "lohhon" (mixed vegetables) or their many exotic and delicious "taufu" (beancurd) dishes that complement most of the seafood well.Overall, this is a decent place with a generally acceptable level of service. Their seafood offerings very competitively priced. However, if you have a preference for ambience on a casual date night, do consider taking a leisure walk down the road, in the direction of the new Cenang Mall, to Orkid Ria's!...btw, bon appetit!
Restaurant: Qiang Shi Fu cenang Seafood Restaurant
Location: Jalan Pantai Chenang, Kampung Lubok Buaya, Langkawi, Kedah

We had flower crab spicy, Grouper sweet & sour fish, Long Bean with sambal, sizzling pork,  black pepper prawn, salted egg squid, veg beancurd, black pepper …MoreAll the dishes we ordered had been consistenly good. Fried rice was really tasty. We had flower crab spicy, Grouper sweet & sour fish, Long Bean with sambal, sizzling pork,  black pepper prawn, salted egg squid, veg beancurd, black pepper chicken. RM 310 for 5 person.Favourite is salted egg squid, fried to that perfect crisp and not oily with light taste of coated salted egg that balance the dish. And also black pepper prawn, Fresh and peppery. Lastly, Fish is excellent, crispy on the outside and tender inside. At first was quite hestiant to try as our first stop at another place was horrid.  Highly recommend to try ROOTIAN.Only cons is, it seemed like the boss need ensure staff give the order correctly. They looked kind of unhappy and some confusion. Overall, it was the best meal we had while we were there.

Author: Fedde den Boer
Review: The 2 meals my partner and I enjoyed at Makan Mana Ikan Bakar were 2 of the very best and most memorable meals we enjoyed during our stay on Langkawi and in Malaysia. …MoreThe 2 meals my partner and I enjoyed at Makan Mana Ikan Bakar were 2 of the very best and most memorable meals we enjoyed during our stay on Langkawi and in Malaysia.Makan Mara Ikan Bakar blew us away with its super fresh ingredients, its adventurous seasoning (while not overpowering the original flavour of the fresh produce) and with the fact that all the seafood & veggies/dishes were grilled, fried or steamed to perfection. We could select our own fish, squid and crab and even the way of cooking (stuffed squid? DE-LI-CIOUS! Grilled prawns? EPIC!). Although the choices are endless, the staff was super friendly and helpful in assisting with our selection, to make sure that we would enjoy our meals.I could (and will, as matter of fact) go on about the skills of the entire family/team; the fish would fall of the bone at the slightest touch, while the steamed mixed vegetables had a rich flavour and were still offering a great bite. The fried egg of the nasi was spectacularly seared with a deep brown crust, while the yolk was still slightly runny. The fried calamari were simply the best and most crunchy I've ever tasted, and how cool that you could actually select the squids yourself. And that marinade... That marinade should be qualified as a hard drug because it is addictively good! Did I already mention that the family cooks as a well-oiled machine and managed to get all the food out at the same time? This was actually the first time we experienced this in Malaysia.We originally came for the superb food, but we returned (and are definitely planning to come back) for the very welcoming and quality company of the family running the restaurant, who were nothing short of amazing and very welcoming hosts. We learned that the restaurant is quite young (4 months old), but with this level of cooking and welcoming vibe this restaurant will remain to be packed/crowded (full restaurant on both nights) as both locals and tourists seem to love Makan Mana Ikan Bakar.I would highly recommend to eat here (do make sure you arrive with an empty stomach...) and to get to know the lovely family running the restaurant, both for foodies and for people who appreciate great, super fresh sea food and quality company!
Location: Lot 2764, Jalan Kuala Muda, Pantai Cenang, Langkawi, Kedah

Review: One of the things I missed when I moved away from the city was the accessibility to quality Japanese food. Tokyo restaurant did not disappoint on my 1st visit. Tokyo restaurant did not disappoint on my 1st visit. A minimalistic and warm atmosphere paired with the courteous and friendly staff already impressed upon me that I would be guaranteed a good meal. Featuring a menu that is heavy on sushi, sashimi, rolls and makis, it's a good place to fix sudden cravings for a wholesome Japanese meal. Of all I've tried tonight, my favourite has got to be the Inari sushi, simple but packed with surprise ingredients that made me order double.

Review: (Translated by Google) The best sushi restaurant in all of Langkawi. The price is cheaper than Unkaizan Restaurant in Pantai Tengah and the quality and taste of the food is better. Sashimi terutamanya Salmon, tuna dan local fish sangat segar dan sedap. Kualiti sushi juga terbaik. Miso soup dan apertizer juga sangat lazat. Steamboat items were 6 types of vegetables including baby spinach, Chinese cabbage, kang kong and choy sum; various types of Yong tao fu, crabsticks, …MoreWe went for the eat all U can steamboat & BBQ dinner. RM38/adult, RM19/child under 11. Steamboat items were 6 types of vegetables including baby spinach, Chinese cabbage, kang kong and choy sum; various types of Yong tao fu, crabsticks, fish balls, yee mee, tang hoon, instant noodles and fresh eggs. BBQ items were beef, shrimps & chicken. There were also fried rice, fresh salad, cold ham slices, cold pasta salad, longan almond dessert, mango pudding and 2 types of cakes. Service was good hotel standard, one waiter named Prem was very attentive and helpful. He even offered to help us take a family photo. We enjoyed his service very much. As for the food, we wouldn't patronise again. Everything served was so-so. One can easily find better tasting food somewhere with the same amount of money or even less in Langkawi.

Author: Jeetendra Singh
Review: Lovey place, lovely food and lovey people. What more could one want. This Turkish restaurant is at a quiet harbor front with variety of sail boats and yacht docked just 10 metres away. The night view is magnificent with mountain silhouettes …MoreLovey place, lovely food and lovey people. What more could one want. This Turkish restaurant is at a quiet harbor front with variety of sail boats and yacht docked just 10 metres away. The night view is magnificent with mountain silhouettes as the backdrop. We sat down and ordered our hummus and baba ganoush. The ever smiling and lively attendant smilingly offered to take it back if we don't like it. That came more as a confidence in their food preparation and helped us settle down. We even tried Turkish coffee and Shisha, both made and served with the same effervescence as their other Turkish delights.They made sure that we do not lack anything while we are sitting there. The demands of songs were met by offering us to plug in our playlist into their music system. We enjoyed all kinds of music to set the mood, right from some Turkish saz, Hollywood to Bollywood music.The Turkish kofte with Pilaf were not only served so nicely but the presentation was also great. The staff laid it out nicely,  proud and sure of their preparation. The taste was awesome, very balanced spices, keeping the originality of distinct flavor and aroma of these Turkish delicacies.Do not miss on this wholesome fine dining experience, whenever and wherever you are in Langkawi. I am sure, you will be enjoy it as much as we all did....
Location: C9, Perdana Quay Telaga Harbour Park, Pantai Kok, Langkawi, Kedah

Happy to report that this little cafe succeeded in crossing that bar very well. Artistically done this small cafe dishes out some amazing food for all types of taste buds. Be it Asian food or pastas the taste and quality is impeccable. The food is also well priced and with good portion sizes. Desserts selection is small but don't miss the banana crumble with ice cream is to die for. Happy hours between 5-7pm also offer good deals on beers. The only point of improvement is that if you are sitting in the upper section you really need to shout out for service as the staff are mostly downstairs, but nevertheless they do revert the moment you call. Do put this on your list when visiting langkawi.

Author: Joshua Doyle
Review: If you're staying in Kuah as an expat, chances are you'll be at one of the posh hotels in the south-east corner of the island and will be looking to put together a list of affordable but decent local eateries. Arts Cafe should absolutely be …MoreIf you're staying in Kuah as an expat, chances are you'll be at one of the posh hotels in the south-east corner of the island and will be looking to put together a list of affordable but decent local eateries. Arts Cafe should absolutely be on that list. You can even combine the trip with your duty-free shopping, as two of the best alcohol shops are on the same road!As for the place itself, it had as much charm and character as the name suggests and makes great use of its small space. We found the servers attentive and it was thanks to one of their recommendations that I had such a good meal.Portion sizes are decent. As much as I love pasta,  I usually avoid it when eating out due to the small portions, but my wife ordered the carbonara and ended up having to take some away, so generous was the portion. I would recommend the beef rendang with roti cenai, which was as good a rendang as I've had in Malaysia, but the menu is broad enough that there's something for everyone and you won't be breaking the bank, so come and decide for yourself!
Location: 54, Jalan Pandak Mayah 5 Kuah, Langkawi, Kedah

Author: Chris Rock
Review: A most delicious meal with super nice staff!  We came came here on our last day on Lagkawi, after seeing the skybridge. I’m so glad we did!  There were tons of options to satisfy all palettes, including seafood, lamb, and chicken dishes. …MoreA most delicious meal with super nice staff!  We came came here on our last day on Lagkawi, after seeing the skybridge. I’m so glad we did!  There were tons of options to satisfy all palettes, including seafood, lamb, and chicken dishes. There was no way to try everything, but I would love to come back some time in the future. We got an appetizer sampler platter with three types of hummus / baba ganoush, a couple dolmades, a variety of olives, and bread.For a main course we went with one chicken shistouk (pieces of grilled chicken) meal, and one biryani chicken quarter meal. The shistouk came with French Fries, and the biryani with rice. The spices and flavors were super tasty and easy on our western palate (we haven’t had much Arabic food, but after this meal we want more!).The restaurant itself has an inside and outside seating area, and the outside covered patio looked like it had a nice breeze. The food came out amazingly quickly- both for us and the other tables we saw get served. The women who took our order were so nice and so helpful and responsive.  Overall great place.
Location: Jalan Kuala Teriang, KAMPUNG RANGGUT, Langkawi, Kedah

Review: Departures (domestic) currently under renovations. We entered into the lounge to find no water machines (there are outside, before you go through security),  one tiny convenience store as well as a cafe with about 4 tables. The store is WH Smith and had very little. They sold instant noodles but there isn’t any water here to make them!The cafe had standard hot drinks at airport prices. Usually you can at least sit in vaguely nicer surroundings but they just have tables in the  terminal. They had mostly sold out of food when we were here too.All of the gates are in the same place which means you’ve got hundreds of people in the same place. They have one convenient charging station in the middle with a tiny ledge to put phones on. Of course there are phones stacked on top of each other. There is a random “charge station” at the back but it has two chairs and two desks. Of course two people just sit their and use laptops. If you want to charge it’s still a nightmare as you’ve got to hover of them and others around this weird desk.The security process was quick. I would leave it until the last minute before you go through. There are a few cafes, restaurants and shops before you go through security. You can also take water through security, perhaps because it’s domestic.

Author: Jonathan Leong
Review: I'm usually not one to be fussy with food, but this restaurant (if you can call it that) has truly crossed the line. First off, the service here is horrible and one of the worst I have ever experienced. It took quite some time and effort …MoreI'm usually not one to be fussy with food, but this restaurant (if you can call it that) has truly crossed the line. First off, the service here is horrible and one of the worst I have ever experienced. It took quite some time and effort just to get the attention of one of the staff to take our order. We then proceeded to wait for what felt like ages for our food to arrive. Whenever we asked any of the staff about our order, they would either gesture us to wait or simply ignore us. What really pushed me over the edge was when 2 other larger pax-sized tables, who came to the restaurant AFTER us, had received their food before we did. After almost an hour, our food finally arrived. When I mentioned to the staff who served us about how long it took, there was no reaction or any explanation from her. Not even a word of sorry. As for the food itself, it must have been 5 star quality for how long it took to be prepared, right? Dead wrong. The food was bang average, and on the borderline of being terrible. The meat was tough and dry, the kangkung was tasteless and the tomyam soup was nothing special. What a waste of time and money, I would not recommend this place to any sane person. I would rather eat dirt from the street than to go through that stressful ordeal again.
Location: Kampung Lubok Buaya, Langkawi, Kedah
