I painted in detail, since I usually read reviews before visiting unfamiliar establishments, this time unfortunately I did not read it. We chose this cafe, as it is located on a lake with a beautiful view! The waiter who took the order constantly shoved the most expensive dishes. We have chosen: pepperoni pizza (35RM), fresh salad (15RM), orange fresh (15RM) and lime fresh (12RM). In the amount of 77RM, + 10% service charge: 84.7RM. He asks: pizza with seafood? Tried to sell it, as it cost 55RM. While we were waiting for the order, we noticed that the next table was unhappy with the check, which alerted us. Also alerted that another waiter was drunk. Asked for an invoice, the amount was: 93 RM. We went to the bar, where the menu was, to make sure the prices were correct. On the check, instead of a fresh salad, they wrote Greek, which cost 20RM, and the price of lime fresh on the check is 15RM, instead of 12RM. After we poked the waiter at these “mistakes”, he made a blank face and silently corrected everything without even apologizing. Apparently constantly so fool customers. We choose grilled cheese.Like Malaysia, where there are many Muslims, there are many places that don't sell beer in restaurants, so those who enjoy alcohol will need to check before ordering food.Fortunately, this is a restaurant that sells alcohol, so I only drank a can.I have a beer in the refrigerator at the hostel, so I have to drink it at the end of the rest of the day...ㅋThe total amount of meals seems to be about 65,000 won, but I didn't think it was expensive because two people ate drinks, lobster, fried rice, and seafood salad. But it's not cheap.....heheIf you enjoyed it well, it would be it.. hehUnfortunately, all the restaurants I went to in Langkawi were Thai restaurants.I also wanted to experience Malaysian food culture, but I didn't want to overdo it on a short schedule, and I always have a chance...Taking this trip as an opportunity, I think it would be good if I had better preparation for the next trip to Malaysia/Langkawi.(Original)오후에 한번 씩 비가 내리긴 했지만 양이 많지 않았다.너무 너무 더웠고 밤 비행기 덕분에 잠도 제대로 못자서 독수리 광장 찍고 숙소(트로피칼 리조트, Tropical Resort)에 와서 잠을 청했다.어둠이 서서히 깔리기 일보 직전에 깨서 해변의 멋진 노을은 볼 수 있었다.조만간 해변의 노을 포스트도 써보도록 해야겠다.해변에서 사진을 찍고 바다를 멍하니 바라보고 있다보니 배가 고파왔다.오토바이 타고 나가면 맥주 한잔도 못 할것 같아 숙소 주변에서 찾아 보기로 하고 무작정 숙소를 나왔다.근처에 식당들이 많이 있으니 직접 보고 선택하면 될 듯.우린 로브스터를 먹으려고 했는데 숙소 가까이에 전문점이 있긴 했지만 외관부터 비싸 보여서 패스하고 인근 해산물 식당을 둘러보며 탐색하다가 발견한 곳이 랑카위 해산물 맛집으로 인정할 만한 타이쉐프(Thai Chef Seafood Restaurant)밖에 해산물들을 직접 볼 수 있어서 조금 더 좋았던 곳 같다.메뉴판 사진 좀 찍으려고 했는데 아쉽게도 실패.다행히 영수증은 버리지 않아서 대략적인 가격은 알 수 있었다.로브스터는 요리방법이 몇가지 있었던 것으로 기억한다. 우린 치즈구이를 선택.무슬림이 많은 말레이시아답게 식당에 맥주 안파는 곳도 많이 있으니 술을 즐기시는 분들은 음식 주문전에 먼저 확인이 필요할 것 같다.다행스럽게도 이 곳은 술을 파는 식당이라 간단하게 한캔 정도만 마셨다.숙소 냉장고에 넣어둔 맥주 있으니 나머진 하루 마감하며 마셔야겠다...ㅋ식사금액이 총 65,000원 정도 되는 것 같은데 2명이서 음료와 로브스터, 볶음밥, 해산물 샐러드까지 먹은거라 비싸다고 생각하진 않았다. 그렇다고 뭐 싼 것도 아니고.....ㅎㅎ맛있게 잘 먹었으면 그것으로 된거지..ㅎ공교롭게도 랑카위에서 갔던 식당이 모두 타이 레스토랑이었네.말레이시아 식문화도 체험해 보고 싶었는데 짧은 일정에 또 너무 무리하고 싶지도 않았고 기회는 언제든지 있으니까...^^;이번 여행을 계기로 다음 말레이시아/랑카위 여행은 좀 더 준비 잘해서 오면 좋을 것 같다는 생각이 든다.ㅋ

Author: Elly Kamal
Review: Some of the glowing reviews were misleading. I don't even know where to start with this place. Ordered mushroom soup and it was salty. Complained and was given a 'new cup' - which in actual fact was the original soup diluted with hot water. …MoreSome of the glowing reviews were misleading. I don't even know where to start with this place. Ordered mushroom soup and it was salty. Complained and was given a 'new cup' - which in actual fact was the original soup diluted with hot water. They don't even bother changing to a new cup or replace the used soup spoon. And the cup had a rather large chip on the lip! Oh and the garlic bread? It's just normal bread, poorly buttered.Then we ordered the Surf & Turf. They ran out of Rib Eye so substituted it with lamb chop. The meat was so tough and rubbery that it was hardly edible. The so called King Prawns were not what it claimed to be. It was tasteless and chalky - a sure sign of it not being fresh. And the squid strips - just a mess of not fresh squid sliced thinly and pan fried in black pepper sauce. And all this crappy food costs us RM67!Disappointing doesn't even begin to describe. I'm absolutely livid that they have the gall to continue charging exhorbitant prices for such poor excuse for food. Definitely would not recommend to anyone to try this place.
Location: 2, Jalan Pantai Chenang, Langkawi, Kedah

Review: Oh dear....where do I start? This restaurant is part of the Sandy Beach Resort and is situated on Cenang Beach. The views from this place at sunset is stunning. There is also ample outdoor seating. The food served here, however, is bad. …MoreOh dear....where do I start? This restaurant is part of the Sandy Beach Resort and is situated on Cenang Beach. The views from this place at sunset is stunning. There is also ample outdoor seating. The food served here, however, is bad. Ordered the mixed grill platter, fried seafood kuey tiaw (flat noodles) and a sausage ( hot dog). The mixed grill platter had fries, shredded cabbage, a whole lot of mayo, half a lamb chop cut in two, half a sirloin, and a thin slice of chicken breast. The meat was tough and tasted like cardboard. The black pepper sauce that came as a side was not good at all. The flat noodles were not great. The hot dog was just a small chicken sausage placed in an empty bun. Condiments were offered that consisted of runny tomato ketchup and mayo. What was advertised was caramelized onions and mustard!!! Music in the covered section was loud and awful. I simply cannot recommend this place and am embarassed that they even serve what they serve to our tourists!!! Abysmal!!!

We loved their food so much, we rented a car from Chenang beach to eat here 3 times in our 7 days there (October 2021).Details:-Their chicken tandoori is well cooked and full of flavor and the chicken tasted fresh. Wit their nasi arab dish, the spices on the side make the rice and chicken the must have dish .-Their cheese naans were very tasty, wish they were bigger.-Their parathas/ aloo and plain are also very authentic Pakistani and had a feeling of being homemade-To top it off their masala tea is 10/10-Honorable mentions to their beef kebabs, and chicken tikka boti!-Their prices are also very very reasonableOverall:Finding good food when going on vacation can sometimes be stressful, because you don't know where the locals go to eat good food, and instead are surrounding by restaurants that sell over priced and un-fresh food.We were lucky to Food Paradise and they managed to blow our expectations, and we will ALWAYS go here whenever we go to Langkawi!Thanks Kashif and the rest of the very friendly and hospitable staff!!

Author: Michelle Yip
Review: I was never a big vegan fan, perhaps due to the fact that I've not tried one that really left an impression. A fair number of vegan places I've visited in Kuala Lumpur offered a great variety on their menus, but in my opinion, the …MoreI was never a big vegan fan, perhaps due to the fact that I've not tried one that really left an impression. A fair number of vegan places I've visited in Kuala Lumpur offered a great variety on their menus, but in my opinion, the attraction of vegan dishes should be focused on their greatest assets; the freshness and quality of their ingredients. Kolma was spot on for both areas. Let's just say that I didn't know fresh kale tasted so good.Kolma is not only about the food, but also about the ambience; quaint, tranquil and intimate. Great place to catch up with friends or chill with a book or Netflix over food. And big kudos to them for allocating space in the shop to feature handcrafted items from Langkawi artisans.I might have been enticed to visit Kolma because of their well curated aesthetics in the form of the food and social media channels, but I definitely will be back because of the quality of the food and their staff. It felt like home. Them allowing my on-leash dog to do outdoor dining with me was also a plus. Also, I'm a sucker for interesting desserts, and Kolma make theirs so guilt-free.
Location: Jalan Pantai Tengah, Kampung Lubok Buaya, Langkawi, Kedah
